{{Quote|I am Captain Evlen, commanding officer of the Tyrant.|Evlen|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Evlen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], commanding [[Darth Tormen]]'s [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]: the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] [[Tyrant (Harrower-class)|''Tyrant'']]. Evlen was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the ''Tyrant'' was boarded by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces during the [[Battle of Rabaan]].<ref name="TOR" />
